# Why cyclists should share their LiveTrack location with Waze


November 19, 2026


By Garmin team


### *Learn how LiveTrack™ encourages Waze drivers to stay more alert to Garmin cyclists*


Whether you’re a seasoned or entry-level cyclist, we know peace of mind on the road is your top priority. That’s why we have numerous bike products, like bike computers, radars and tail lights, that can help cyclists and motorists be mindful of each other on the road.


Helping drivers be more aware of nearby cyclists, cyclists can opt to share their[LiveTrack location](https://support.garmin.com/en-US/?faq=HbqxxbiBGA3mDhlLX4GUw8) 1 with the Waze driving app. So, if you ride with an[Edge® bike computer](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/c/sports-fitness/cycling-bike-computers-bike-radar-power-meter-headlights/?series=BRAND482#shopallcycling) or[compatible Garmin smartwatch](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/c/wearables-smartwatches/) , here’s how Waze drivers can become more aware of your ride.


## What is Waze?


[Waze](https://www.waze.com/about/) is a community-driven navigation app used by 200 million drivers around the world that provides directions and up-to-date road conditions. Drivers using Waze will be notified of traffic, hazards, road closures and more as they navigate to their desired location.


## What is the benefit of sharing your location with the Waze driving app while cycling?


Waze users will have more awareness of daily commuters and competitive cyclists when cyclists share their real-time LiveTrack location.


Just as Waze drivers are alerted to upcoming road conditions, they will receive a moving alert when cyclists who opt to share their LiveTrack locations during an outdoor ride are nearby. These alerts offer drivers[greater awareness to cyclists](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/garmin-technology/cycling-science/cycling-awareness/) up ahead, so you can share the road with more confidence.


Consider also outfitting your bike with an Edge bike computer,[Varia™ rearview radar tail lights and smart lights](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/c/sports-fitness/cycling-bike-computers-bike-radar-power-meter-headlights/?series=BRAND10561#shopallcycling) for added[visibility between both cyclist and motorist](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/blog/fitness/cycling/5-ways-to-help-stay-safe-while-cycling/) .


*Allow nearby Waze drivers to see your LiveTrack location to help foster a safer riding environment.*


## How does it work?


To get started, simply opt in via the[Garmin Connect™ app](https://connect.garmin.com/) to share your LiveTrack location when using your compatible Garmin device, like an Edge cycling computer or compatible Garmin smartwatch, and connected smartphone. By selecting yes, your LiveTrack location will be shared during outdoor ride activities, and[drivers will start getting notifications](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/garmin-technology/cycling-science/cycling-awareness/your-live-location-in-waze/?cdncache=false) when you’re pedaling nearby. Your location will only be shared with Waze drivers when an outdoor ride activity has begun. Aside from location, no other personal information will be shared or displayed with Waze.


Round out your cycling setup with more safety-focused gear. Before you hit the road, share your location with Waze drivers using an[Edge cycling computer](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/c/sports-fitness/cycling-bike-computers-bike-radar-power-meter-headlights/?series=BRAND482#shopallcycling) or Garmin smartwatch with LiveTrack.
